description: This file defines the CustomFieldService class within the OrangeHRM system, providing methods for managing custom fields in the HRM system, including generating field keys, retrieving DAO instances, and manipulating employee custom field data.

classes.name: CustomFieldService
classes.description: A service class for managing employee custom fields, including generating field keys and interacting with the DAO layer.

methods.name: getCustomFieldDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the CustomFieldDao instance used for database operations related to custom fields.

methods.name: generateGettersByFieldNumbers
methods.description: Generates getter method names for a list of custom field numbers.

methods.name: generateFieldKeyByFieldId
methods.description: Creates a field key string from a field number, e.g., 'custom1'.

methods.name: generateSetterByFieldKey
methods.description: Creates a setter method name from a field key, e.g., 'setCustom1'.

methods.name: extractFieldNumbersFromFieldKeys
methods.description: Extracts field numbers from an array of field key strings.

methods.name: deleteRelatedEmployeeCustomFieldsExtraData
methods.description: Deletes extra data associated with a custom field for employees if the data is no longer in use.

methods.name: getAllFieldsInUse
methods.description: Retrieves a list of custom field numbers currently in use, up to a maximum of 10.
